newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 512 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 512 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 512 contracts compared with 856 overnight Monday.
There were 209 wheat, 67 corn, 177 soybean, 46 soymeal, 10 soyoil, one oat and two wheat puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one cent higher to one cent lower, corn was steady to 1/2 cent higher and soybeans were steady to one cent higher.
